run_interactive_play: run the interactive play script to manually control a robot in the Habitat environment with PyGame
run_play_env: run the play_env loop to render observations, handle input, and record robot actions
run_step_env: run step_env to execute a named action with arguments in the Habitat environment
create_free_cam_helper: create a FreeCamHelper instance to toggle free camera mode with translation and rotation controls
create_get_input_vel_ctlr: create a velocity controller that maps PyGame keyboard keys to arm and base actions
